sections.label: The opening
sections.line: A storm, a summit and a site built in a night: a weather face over a data room, every figure sourced, timed and labelled.
sections.para: When Storm Charles led Web Summit to call off Day 2, about thirty agents built storm-charles.promptugal.news overnight: about 2,000 pages, each push live in about forty seconds. A weather page in front; behind it 34 hashed datasets, a timeline, decisions, entities and captured evidence, all labelled fact, evidence or hypothesis. Labs, stories, a graph, SQLite in the browser, model evals, animations, and a journal of its own making and cost. Part of PrompTugal.news.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: A storm, a night, two faces, data all the way down, many views, a journal that tells on itself, not a warning service.
sections.para: Seven points from the site as read on 11 November.

sections.label: What happened
sections.line: IPMA named Charles; red warnings, an alert situation, the Prime Minister's advice, and Web Summit's Day 2 called off at 19:09 UTC.
sections.para: Each line is on the site with its source and the time it was read.

sections.label: How it started
sections.line: A voice memo at 21:00 UTC, a first commit at 21:14, and six more directions before 03:00.
sections.para: More agents, a Studio, a Wikipedia agent, two faces, a budget and an accountant; one agent until 23:35, twenty-two by 02:36.

sections.label: Two faces over one data room
sections.line: A weather face for anyone, over a data room the front reads from.
sections.para: Catalogue of 34 datasets with hashes, timeline with permanent ids, decisions, 215 entities, captured and hashed evidence in vaults, and three labels everywhere.

sections.label: Many ways to see one storm
sections.line: Lead times, a replay of what was known when, lanes, stations, and what followed each warning.
sections.para: Stories checked on every build, a graph you ask questions of, an ontology of eight kinds and nine verbs, and SQLite in the browser.

sections.label: The team, the evidence and the record
sections.line: The site shows its own machinery: team, board, meteorology, research, model evals, Studio and design.
sections.para: 67 pushes an hour, 40 seconds to served, 31 agents; 106 weather sites; 1,291 model calls costed against a 20 dollar cap.

sections.label: It tells on itself
sections.line: A journal for readers arriving cold, with its own corrections and its costs.
sections.para: About a dollar in model calls, an empty provider account, and 2,069 million session tokens, 98.7% re-reading.

sections.label: Part of PrompTugal.news
sections.line: A section of PrompTugal.news, our independent newsroom at Web Summit, with the same rules.
sections.para: Sources and labels on everything, and a person who sends every outside message.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Not a warning service; the site's own figures as read; a night old; team members not named.
sections.para: It lists what does not exist yet.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: The site's pages, brief, journal, catalogue and llms.txt, PrompTugal.news, and earlier newsroom articles.
